title: I raro i te marumaru o te nikau tāte
intro: He kōrero e whāia ana mō tētahi wairua i wehea i mua i tōna whānautanga, i atawhaitia i roto i ngā pakitara tapu, ā, i whiriwhiria kia mau i tētahi tohu kāore anō kia kitea e te ao. I te putanga mai o te whakapae mai i ngā taha katoa, ka puta mai he reo mai i ngā wāhi tino kore e taea te whakapono hei whakamutu i te feaa katoa. Ka taea e koe te kite ko wai i haere i raro i te marumaru o te nikau tāte?
clues: I whakatapua ahau ki te mahi a te Kaha Rawa i mua i taku whakamānawa tuatahi, he oati nā te mea nāna ahau i kawe.
I tipu ake ahau i raro i te manaakitanga o tētahi kaitiaki tika i roto i ngā rūma tapu o te whare karakia.
I ngā wā katoa e haere mai ai taku kaitiaki ki tōku rūma, ka kitea e ia he kai māku nō ngā wā o te tau kāore i tika kia pērā.
I tae mai ngā rongopai pai mō tētahi tama, ahakoa kāore i rite te wāhi mō ngā mea i whakaaria mai i runga i tōku āhua.
I haere atu ahau ki tētahi wāhi tawhiti, ā, i reira tētahi nikau tāte i taumarumaru mai ki ahau, i te mea e rere ana tētahi awa i raro.
I te taenga mai o te whakapae, i te karapotinga mai hoki o ngā pātai, ka tohu atu ahau ki taku tamaiti whānau hou — ā, i kōrero mai ia mai anō i te whanga ki te whakamutu i ngā feaa katoa.

arabic: فَنَادَىٰهَا مِن تَحْتِهَآ أَلَّا تَحْزَنِى قَدْ جَعَلَ رَبُّكِ تَحْتَكِ سَرِيًّۭا
verse: But he called her from below her, "Do not grieve; your Lord has provided beneath you a stream. (19:24)
